answer.says: Thank you, Ramesh. I will wait here.
answer.thought: The system of needs is restored by a single act of grace. Ramesh’s paratha is not charity; it is the ethical substance of the household, the family, functioning where the state’s machinery has ground to a halt. I sit in the study and wait for the smell of oil to cross the threshold.
